name: Defending
description: Braced behind your guard: +2 AC until the end of your next turn.

name: Grave Chill
description: The cold of the grave numbs your limbs: disadvantage on attack rolls.

name: Vigilant
description: You stand your watch unbroken and see every blow coming: +2 AC and advantage on attack rolls.

name: Wren's Ward
description: Sister Wren's ashen blessing hangs about you like censer smoke: +2 AC.

name: Unburdened Focus
description: The Iron Reliquary's standard steadies your hand and quiets your fear: +1 AC and advantage on attack rolls.
